about.para: I combine my deep user empathy with my problem-solving mindset to build products that I am proud of. I am complementing my background in IT with MBA, developing skills to bridge gap between business goals and user needs.

timeline.skill_gained: Co-led founding team in launch of AI FinOps platform, owning the 0→1 product roadmap & UI/UX strategy. I am heavily involved in the feature discovery and prioritization of the efforts.
I worked on EY projects with the state government, calculating bankability of projects, building sample dashboards to show to our clients.

Identified product opportunity to eliminate 5+ Lakhs of upfront feasibility cost that Carbon project developers bear, roadmapped a the product and conducted extensive research of methodologies and developed logical decision trees.
I understood how important sustainability is if we want to progress at the same speed with tech and AI innovations. I am learning business with a sustainability lens.

Started as a junior salesforce developer working with a fortune 500 banking client to translate their user needs into creative salesforce solutions. I participated in product backlog refinement sessions, contributing my technical expertise and aligning development effort with business goals.
With epic product, you need an epic visibility. This is where I learned how to opmitize a website for SEO.
Engineering taught me a lot of things. I gained my theoretical knowledge from here and applied on multiple projects I worked on during this.

projects.title: Giving relationship managers their time back
projects.problem: RMs serving high-net-worth and senior clients lose hours to routine requests, which caps how many clients they can serve well.
projects.key decision: Prioritized the usecases to be implemented in the MVP based on the time saved for RMs.
projects.impact: PoC led to a new $5M engagement.

projects.title: Students no longer miss deadlines
projects.problem: Missed deadlines and lack of visibility for assignment and test dates
projects.key decision: Designed a Google Workspace Flow which automatically checks emails for deadlines and creates google calendar events to track effectively.

projects.title: Pay for what you eat
projects.problem: Students had to pay for mess food even if they didn't eat, leading to food wastage and paying for more.
projects.key decision: Created a prototype for a College Mess Management portal where students only pay for what they want to eat. Mess management analyzes students' attendance data over time and plan better.
